# Logo customization

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Material Design 3, appearance, and layout · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

main.ts `LOGO_KEY`, `#logo-up`, `#logo-reset`

## What is missing

several built-in logo presets; crop/fit/focal point/safe area/background editor; byte-level decode check (only a data-URL regex; animated GIF accepted); loading/converted/error states; history, schedule and palette entries; site and Deploy app
